scripts./build_explanation: ALWAYS use full `npm run build` to build washm.wasm, so that vital steps are applied properly.
scripts.build: echo washm.wasm... && cargo build -p washm-shell --release --target wasm32-wasip1 --features wasm-test && node -e "fs.copyFileSync('../target/wasm32-wasip1/release/washm_shell.wasm', 'washm.wasm')" && echo washm.debug.wasm... && cargo build -p washm-shell --target wasm32-wasip1 --features wasm-test && node -e "fs.copyFileSync('../target/wasm32-wasip1/debug/washm_shell.wasm', 'washm.debug.wasm')"
